content.name: Elusive
entries: Beginning at 18th level, you are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

content.name: Elusive
entries: You're so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll can have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} against you unless you have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.
